title: FinanceMath literal-normalized singleton review queue

construction.ordering: validation first, then test; numeric source question ID within each split
construction.excluded_from_this_queue: All members of the 13 existing literal-normalized code clusters (28 records); those remain in their separate provisional manual-review record.
construction.content_policy: No source question text, solution code, answers, or generated equations are copied into this queue.

review_contract: Queue membership is not evidence of a distinct equation or independent family.
Do not assign a canonical family ID until mathematical equivalence, parameterization, and shared-generator relationships have been reviewed.
Review table-dependent candidates against retained source tables and source provenance; do not infer equations from topic labels.
Compare candidate equations against canonical Core-15 and pinned historical-74 formula definitions, not names alone.
Keep exact duplicates, algebraic equivalence, shared family/template, component overlap, related concepts, and statistical independence as separate judgments.
Preserve validation/test provenance. Do not use test outcomes to tune formulas or tau; test labels are public and do not constitute a blind benchmark.
Only independently adjudicated families can later be considered for family-disjoint cohorts. Repeated prompts, code variants, and seeds do not create independent units.
No cohort assignment, calibration eligibility, evaluation eligibility, routing, or tau decision is made by this queue.
